The '''Processing Plant''' was a mining utility station built by [[Telgorn Corporation]].

==Description==
Processing Plants were structures built to process minerals extracted from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and other astronomical bodies with [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. They were generally placed near [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="XWA" />

The Processing Plant was designed for human habitation, with a small command center located at the end of a long spine, and a small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in the central section. Total crew complement was 187 beings. The station was unarmed, but did have a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="XWA" />

==History==
The Processing Plant was built by [[Telgorn Corporation]], a company that produced several types of [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. They were used by a variety of organizations.<ref name="XWA" /> At least one Processing Plant was used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to supply the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[AL-82673]] in the asteroid field of the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]].<ref name="xwab6m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 6, Mission 7: "Family Reunion"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Though the station's description in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' lists them as being in use by "various,"<ref name="XWA" /> only one Processing Plant is ever seen, in Battle 6, Mission 7, "Family Reunion."<ref name="xwab6m7" />
